create_benchmark_from_file: create a Benchmark instance from a filesystem path using Benchmark.from_file with a uri and file path
create_benchmark_from_bytes: create a Benchmark instance from raw bytes using Benchmark.from_file_contents with a uri and data
validate_benchmark: validate a Benchmark against a CompilerEnv by calling benchmark.validate(env) to check for errors
add_validation_callback: add a validation callback function to a Benchmark using benchmark.add_validation_callback(callback)
write_benchmark_sources: write benchmark source files to a directory using benchmark.write_sources_to_directory(path)
